description: Generated schema for muster core API tools for test scenario validation

tools.description: Core API tools available in muster serve

app.description: Name of the provider App to grant (a provider instance, e.g. github or gitlab); set server or app

reset_client_registration.description: Register muster's client anew first (RFC 7591); only when sign-ins fail with invalid_client. Other users may have to sign in again.

server.description: Name of the MCP server to authenticate to; set server or app

app.description: Name of the provider App to disconnect; set server or app

server.description: Name of the MCP server to log out from; set server or app

auth_urls.description: Also issue the sign-in link (auth_url) of each server in auth_required or reauth_required; links are yours alone and expire in minutes.

follow.description: Stream new events as they occur (follow mode)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

since.description: Show events after this time (duration like '1h' or RFC3339 timestamp)

until.description: Show events before this time (RFC3339 timestamp)

authorizationServer.description: Pins the OAuth authorization server where the MCP server has no RFC 9728 metadata; with endpoints and a client, one muster can't discover (GitHub)

authorizationEndpoint.description: Authorization endpoint of a server without RFC 8414 discovery; set with tokenEndpoint (muster then does no discovery and assumes S256 PKCE)

clientCredentialsSecretRef.description: Secret holding a client registered out of band (a GitHub App or OAuth App); used instead of muster's CIMD URL or a dynamic registration

clientIdKey.description: Secret key holding the client ID (default: client-id)

clientSecretKey.description: Secret key holding the client secret (default: client-secret)

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret (defaults to the MCPServer's namespace)

expectedIssuer.description: The RFC 9207 iss of authorization responses where it differs from issuer, which stays the grant key; needs both endpoints; default: issuer

grantScope.description: Whose token: session (default, the login session that got it) or subject (the person's; later sessions reuse it until core_auth_logout or sign-out)

issuer.description: OAuth/OIDC issuer URL (HTTPS, no trailing slash) the sign-in runs against and grants are filed under; wins over the one RFC 9728 metadata names

scopes.description: OAuth scope parameter value (space-separated scope tokens)

tokenEndpoint.description: Token endpoint of an authorization server without an RFC 8414 discovery document; set together with authorizationEndpoint

forwardIdentity.description: Send the session's ID token in X-Muster-Id-Token next to the pinned grant (needs oauth and authorizationServer); not audience-scoped to the server

requiredAudiences.description: Additional audiences to request from IdP for token or identity forwarding (e.g., dex-k8s-authenticator for Kubernetes OIDC)

sigv4.description: AWS SigV4 request signing with muster's own machine identity; required when type is sigv4, rejected otherwise; streamable-http only

region.description: SigV4 signing region; must match the region in the server URL

roleArn.description: IAM role assumed from the pod's base credentials before signing; empty signs as the pod's own identity

service.description: SigV4 signing service name; defaults to the first hostname label of the server URL

tokenExchange.description: RFC 8693 Token Exchange for cross-cluster SSO: trades muster's local token for one from the remote cluster's IdP (wins over forwardToken)

clientCredentialsSecretRef.description: Kubernetes Secret with client credentials for the remote Dex token endpoint

clientIdKey.description: Key in the secret containing the client ID (default: client-id)

clientSecretKey.description: Key in the secret containing the client secret (default: client-secret)

namespace.description: Secret namespace (defaults to the MCPServer's namespace)

connectorId.description: ID of the OIDC connector on the remote Dex that trusts the local Dex (required when enabled)

dexTokenEndpoint.description: URL of the remote cluster's Dex token endpoint (required when enabled)

enabled.description: Whether token exchange should be attempted

expectedIssuer.description: Expected issuer URL in the exchanged token's iss claim; derived from dexTokenEndpoint if not set

scopes.description: Scopes to request for the exchanged token (default: openid profile email groups)

type.description: Authentication type: oauth, none or sigv4

autoStart.description: Whether server should auto-start; on update, omitted keeps the current value

displayName.description: Name UIs show for the server, stored trimmed in the ui.giantswarm.io/display-name annotation; blank sets none, on update removes it

family.description: Family that this MCP server instance belongs to (groups equivalent servers under a single tool name)

instanceArg.description: Name of the required parameter the LLM uses to select which family member handles a call (e.g. management_cluster, country, model)

headers.description: HTTP headers (streamable-http, sse only); a credential in Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie or X-API-Key is refused: use headersFrom

headersFrom.description: HTTP headers whose values muster reads from a Secret in the server's namespace when it connects (streamable-http and sse only)

meta.description: Entries merged into the params._meta object of every outbound JSON-RPC request that carries params (applied by the sigv4 transport only)

progress.description: How progress the server reports on a tool call affects that call's budget

maxDuration.description: Seconds a tool call reporting progress may run in all; each notification restarts timeout up to it (timeout to 3600, default 3600)

type.description: MCP server type (stdio, streamable-http, or sse)

url.description: Server endpoint URL (required for streamable-http and sse)

name.description: Name of the MCP server to delete

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with the probe requests

name.description: Name of the MCP server to retrieve

showAll.description: Show all servers including unreachable ones (default: false)

verbose.description: Show detailed error information for failed/unreachable servers (default: false)

jq.description: A jq program that reshapes the step's result before it is stored -- the tool's result, or a forEach step's per-iteration records -- so later steps and the output template see only what it yields, e.g. '[.items[] | {name: .metadata.name}]'. $input is the workflow input, $vars the loop variables. It must yield one value: wrap a stream in [ ].

output.description: Whether this sub-step's result is included in the returned document. Results are always referenceable by later steps regardless of this flag.
